sketches.intent: A dry, resonant acid-like bass. Harder notes open a voice-local filter; asymmetric diode-like feedback colors the resonant bite, rather than adding post-filter distortion. Independent Rage-inspired implementation, not copied Arturia presets or a verified Pigments sonic match.

sketches.study_axis: balanced feedback overdrive in a brass-like lead
sketches.intent: A forceful brass-like lead with a short opening vowel and balanced feedback overdrive. Detached phrases expose each filter articulation; not an acoustic brass or transistor circuit model. Independent Rage-inspired implementation, not copied Arturia presets or a verified Pigments sonic match.

sketches.study_axis: soft feedback electric keys with independent chord articulation
sketches.intent: Rounded electric keys with a brief independent FM strike and soft feedback saturation. Staggered chord entrances demonstrate that a new note does not retrigger the other voices' filter envelopes. Independent Rage-inspired implementation, not copied Arturia presets or a verified Pigments sonic match.

sketches.study_axis: slow beating pad with memory-shaped feedback rounding
sketches.intent: A warm, slowly opening chord with near-unison beating and tape-inspired feedback compression/rounding. No tape recording, physical hysteresis or reversed room is claimed; ordinary Space remains downstream. Independent Rage-inspired implementation, not copied Arturia presets or a verified Pigments sonic match.
